rules: Evolution never changes the animal into a different species or character.
Face, core silhouette cues, signature palette and personality remain recognizable through all phases.
Guardian form is the canonical visual anchor for every familiar.
Evolution is driven by cumulative study Bond XP; missed days never reverse an evolution.
Streaks, mastery, boss wins and perfect sessions may award bonus Bond XP but are not required to retain a form.
Future Phaser animation frames must be derived from the canonical character art rather than regenerated as unrelated designs.
